title: Linearity of reconstruction
statement: Let $F$ be a field, let $A$ be a finite set of nonzero elements of $F$, and let $s$ be a finite index set. For any family of shares $h_i(a)\in F$ indexed by $i\in s$ and $a\in A$, reconstructing the pointwise sum of the shares gives the sum of their reconstructions: $\operatorname{recombine}_A\bigl(a\mapsto\sum_{i\in s}h_i(a)\bigr)=\sum_{i\in s}\operatorname{recombine}_A(h_i)$, where reconstruction uses the Lagrange interpolation coefficients at $0$.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is a finite set of nonzero field elements
$h$ assigns a field element to each index and party
